versions.changelog:
Initial release of “新产线/新工厂质量启动策划” skill.

- Provides a structured tool for planning quality launch activities for new production lines/factories (targets, deliverables, quality gates, ramp-up & KPIs).
- Focuses on pre-production launch planning, distinct from Safe Launch/control execution.
- Interactive process collects essential project, quality, and milestone information, producing both Markdown and HTML quality launch plans.
- Clearly defines responsibilities and boundaries; does not generate specific enterprise data that must be provided by the user.
- Integrates with related project and quality management skills upstream and downstream.
